models.title: Income tax expense from current and deferred components
models.summary: The reading adds current tax and the applicable change in deferred tax to obtain income tax expense.

relationship.original_equation: Tax expense = current tax expense + deferred tax expense
relationship.translation_notes: Signed inputs and outputs are expense-positive; a deferred benefit is negative. The accessible Australian standard is cited as corroboration of the matching rule; jurisdiction-specific differences require review.

models.title: Deferred tax liability change from a rate change
models.summary: A change in the applicable rate changes the deferred liability on a fixed taxable temporary difference.

relationship.original_equation: Change in deferred tax liability = temporary difference × (new tax rate - old tax rate)
relationship.translation_notes: Rates are base-one fractions; the sign of output is the change in the liability. The accessible Australian standard is cited as corroboration of the matching rule; jurisdiction-specific differences require review.

models.title: Gain or loss on extinguishment of debt
models.summary: The example calculates a loss as carrying amount less cash paid on redemption.

relationship.original_equation: Gain on debt extinguishment = extinguished carrying amount - consideration

models.title: Eligible specific borrowing costs net of investment income
models.summary: The IFRS example deducts temporary investment income from borrowing costs on funds raised specifically for construction.
